subject: Provisional headroom allocation and proforma acceptance
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@brightcart.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: short-term headroom for product launch

Hi Ben,

We're kicking off a big promo the week of Sep 6 and expect a concentrated burst of inference traffic for ~36 hours. Our account (BrightCart) is on a commit that sits just under the projected peak, and procurement asked me to check whether Redwood can provide a provisional headroom allocation or a short-term spike package we can sign to avoid throttling.

Key asks:
- Temporary quota bump for Sep 6–7 (estimate +60% peak QPS)
- Transparent overrun pricing or a one-off credit if we exceed committed thresholds
- A quick proforma/invoice we can route to procurement before Friday

Can you advise what options you have and an estimated cost? We prefer something we can accept in email or DocuSign to speed approval.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Senior Product Ops, BrightCart
https://brightcart.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightcart.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short-term headroom for product launch

Elena —

Thanks for the heads up. Short answer: yes, we can. Options I recommend (fastest to execute):

1) Provisional headroom allocation (recommended)
- 48-hour temporary quota increase sized to +70% of your current peak QPS (covers buffer)
- Flat uplift fee: $1,500 for the window (covers kernel scheduling and reserved GPU headroom)
- Includes up to 10% credit back if peak stays below +50% of bump

2) Overrun true-up (if you prefer pay-as-you-go)
- Standard overrun rate: 1.6x published per-token rate during the 48-hour window
- We can pre-authorize a cap and notify at 75% usage so you can pause

3) Prepaid micro-burst credit
- We issue a one-off proforma invoice for $2,250 that converts to credit balance applied first to any overrun charges

If you want contractual visibility we can do a short SOW (1 page) + proforma. I'll loop in Finance for the invoice and Jordan for any SLA/legal flags that could affect an approved exception.

If you can confirm the exact time window (UTC) and the contact in procurement who needs the proforma, I'll send a DocuSign-ready SOW and a proforma today.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — North America
Redwood Inference
